payload.purpose_context: Start fresh in schema-baron while preserving the previous Schemabaron experiment as a reference. Match the simpler early Studio page, form, control and contextual-properties workflow using the supplied Studio 1.0 manual and visual references. Support unrelated projects created entirely through the application, safe database evolution, reliable regeneration and independently runnable generated applications.
payload.purpose_tldr: Build a complete early-CodeCharge-Studio-inspired application authoring environment with modern SQLite schema design, application flow visualization, modular TypeScript and Next.js generation, and shared UI and MCP commands.

payload.question: Confirm the whole-app intent: a local-first Studio for human and agent authors, following early CodeCharge Studio page/form/control workflows and compact contextual UI; visual SQLite schema and query builders; public and authenticated generated pages; a model-derived application flow map; modular independently runnable TypeScript/Next.js applications; safe migrations and regeneration preserving data and authored extensions; shared UI/MCP commands from the first slice. Completion requires building and exercising two unrelated applications without hidden schema edits. Initial scope is one SQLite and TypeScript target; hosted collaboration, other database/language targets and exact replication of old bugs are excluded. Packaging and library choices are planning decisions. Is this the intended scope?
